_comment: Aurora-Provider supported LLM providers catalog and models metadata.

opencode_zen.name: OpenCode Zen
opencode_zen.notes: 3 permanently free models. Data used for training during free period.

rateLimits.notes: Undocumented — observed as generous during free period

models.name: Big Pickle
models.notes: Stealth model — identity undisclosed. Strong reasoning. Free for limited time.

models.name: DeepSeek V4 Flash Free
models.notes: 284B MoE, 13B active. 1M context upstream. Free for limited time.

models.name: Nemotron 3 Super Free
models.notes: NVIDIA model. Trial use only — not for production/sensitive data. NVIDIA logs prompts.

zhipu.name: Zhipu AI (Z.AI)
zhipu.notes: Permanently free models — not trial-limited. Email signup only.

rateLimits.notes: 1 concurrent request on free tier. GLM-4.7-Flash permanently free.

models.name: GLM-4.7 Flash
models.notes: SWE-bench 59.2. MoE 30B total/3B active. Best free permanent coding model.

models.name: GLM-4.5 Flash
models.notes: Previous gen flash. Permanently free. Lower capability.

google_ai_studio.name: Google AI Studio (Gemini)
google_ai_studio.notes: Most generous frontier free tier. 1M context. No credit card.

rateLimits.notes: Gemini 2.5 Flash: 30 RPM / 1500 RPD / 1M TPM. Resets daily. Never expires.

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash
models.notes: 1M context. Best free tier overall. 1500 req/day. Strong reasoning + coding.

models.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite
models.notes: Faster, lighter. Higher RPM on free tier.

mistral.name: Mistral AI
mistral.notes: Generous free tier on La Plateforme with RPM limits.

rateLimits.notes: 60 RPM for free tier usage.

cohere.name: Cohere
cohere.notes: Trial API keys provide generous free access.

rateLimits.notes: 100 RPM limit. Extremely fast output (100+ TPS).

groq.name: Groq
groq.notes: Fastest inference (300-1000 TPS). No credit card. Open models only.

rateLimits.notes: Per-model limits. 30 RPM / 6K TPM / 1K RPD for most models.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B Versatile
models.notes: Best Groq model for coding. 200-350 tok/s.

models.name: Llama 4 Scout
models.notes: 512K context on Groq. High speed.

models.name: DeepSeek R1 Distill Llama 70B
models.notes: Reasoning model on Groq. Good for complex tasks.

cloudflare_workers_ai.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
cloudflare_workers_ai.notes: 10K neurons/day free. GDPR-compliant. Hosts frontier Kimi K2.6 free.

rateLimits.notes: 10K neurons/day on free Workers plan. ~500-2000 requests depending on model.

models.name: Kimi K2.6
models.notes: SWE-bench 80.2. Frontier-scale 1T param MoE. Best open coding model 2026.

models.name: Qwen3 30B A3B
models.notes: MoE 3B active. Strong coding + reasoning.

models.name: DeepSeek R1 Distill Qwen 32B
models.notes: Reasoning distill on Cloudflare edge.

models.name: Llama 4 Scout
models.notes: 512K context on Cloudflare edge.

kimi_moonshot.name: Kimi (Moonshot AI)
kimi_moonshot.notes: Tier0 (free): 3 RPM, 1 concurrent, 1.5M TPD. May need Chinese phone.

rateLimits.notes: Tier0 = zero recharge. Very generous token budget but only 3 RPM.

models.name: Kimi K2.5
models.notes: 1T param MoE. 256K context. Strong complex coding.

openrouter.name: OpenRouter (free models)
openrouter.notes: Use :free suffix models. Single API key for all. Rate limits vary by model.

rateLimits.notes: Free models: 20 RPM typically. Lower than dedicated providers.

models.name: DeepSeek V4 Flash (free)
models.notes: 1M context via OpenRouter. 284B MoE.

models.name: Gemma 4 26B A4B (free)
models.notes: Google Gemma 4 model on OpenRouter free tier.

cerebras.name: Cerebras
cerebras.notes: Highest raw throughput: ~2600 tok/s. 1M tokens/day. No credit card.

rateLimits.notes: 1M tokens/day cap. 8K context cap on free tier. Ultra fast.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B
models.notes: 2600 tok/s. Context limited to 8K on free tier. Best for quick tasks.

models.name: Llama 4 Scout
models.notes: Higher context than Llama 3.3 on Cerebras free tier.

rateLimits.notes: Generous but undocumented per-model. Generally 5 RPM on free.

models.name: Kimi K2 Instruct (NIM)
models.notes: Frontier coding model on NVIDIA. 256K context.

models.name: DeepSeek V3.2
models.notes: Latest DeepSeek via NVIDIA NIM free endpoint.

models.name: Nemotron 3 Super 120B
models.notes: MoE 120B/12B active. Strong complex tasks.

github_models.name: GitHub Models
github_models.notes: Free for any GitHub user. 45+ models. Low context limits (8K in / 4K out).

rateLimits.notes: 8K input / 4K output per request. Low RPM. Good for quick tasks.

models.name: Grok 3
models.notes: xAI Grok 3 via GitHub. Rate limits tied to Copilot tier.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B Instruct
models.notes: Standard GitHub Models limit: 4K out.

ofoxai.name: OfoxAI
ofoxai.notes: OpenRouter-compatible aggregator with free model access.

rateLimits.notes: Inherits from upstream provider limits.

models.name: GLM-4.7 Flash Free (OfoxAI)
models.notes: Your currently configured model.

kilo_gateway.name: Kilo Gateway
kilo_gateway.notes: API gateway with various free models.

rateLimits.notes: 200 requests/hour limit typically.

github_copilot.name: GitHub Copilot
github_copilot.notes: Access via GitHub Copilot integration token.

rateLimits.notes: 50 requests/month for free Copilot tier.

huggingface.name: Hugging Face Serverless
huggingface.notes: HuggingFace Router meta-router using each backend's native protocol.

rateLimits.notes: Rate limited based on model congestion and usage quotas.

qwen.name: Qwen (DashScope API)
qwen.notes: Alibaba Cloud DashScope compatible mode. Generous free trial credits.

minimax.name: MiniMax
minimax.notes: MiniMax AI platform. Generous free trial credits.

codestral.name: Codestral (Mistral)
codestral.notes: Codestral API endpoint from Mistral AI. Dedicated coding models.

gitlab_gateway.name: GitLab AI Gateway
gitlab_gateway.notes: GitLab AI Gateway. Access to Code Suggestions and Duo chat.

github_free.name: GitHub Models (Free Marketplace)
github_free.notes: Free Azure-hosted marketplace models for any GitHub account.

rateLimits.notes: Grok models: 1800 RPM / 10M TPM limit.
100 requests per hour limit.
1 concurrent model.
Generous anonymous limits.
